commit_search_summaries.paragraph_1: This commit records a proof-draft criterion for untwisted Drinfeld doubles D(G) on the ordinary separated split test. Invertible simples are pairs (z, chi) with z in Z(G) and chi a linear character, and their twist is chi(z). The split test can be nonbaseline precisely when a central element survives in the abelianization and is seen by a linear character.
commit_search_summaries.paragraph_2: The commit also fixes an important earlier confusion: Z(A4) is trivial, while A4_ab is Z/3. Thus the Z/3 direction in D(A4) is pure charge and bosonic for this split test. This commit is good search material for deciding whether a D(G) candidate is worth even a cheap separated scan.

working_understanding.discussion_summary_zh_hant: 我們剛剛差點把兩個圖混在一起。若一個 closed 4-manifold 沒有 1-handles、也沒有 3-handles，平常給出的 Kirby diagram 是 2-handles 的 attaching link，畫在最初 0-handle 的邊界 S^3 上；但照 Tham Definition 5.11 從下往上做，2-handle map 之後真正留給最後 4-handle 去 evaluate 的，並不是這條 attaching link 本身，而是 surgery 之後 boundary 裡的 belt-core / dual graph。這一度讓人以為：我們以前直接拿 Kirby link 做 RT/link evaluation，是不是少掛了一堆 meridian，所以算錯了。後來解開的方式是：我們其實應該把既有算法理解成從 upside-down / dual Kirby picture 在算。也就是說，Tham 從下往上得到的 belt-core graph，如果改從 4-handle 那一側往回看，就正是畫在原本 4-handle boundary 上的 dual Kirby link。這樣就不用在原始 attaching link 旁邊硬掛 meridian；掛 meridian 是另一種把 dual graph 留在 primal S^3 裡描述的中介做法，還會牽涉 3-dimensional surgery normalization。這個理解還只是工作性整理，尚未當作定理使用。
working_understanding.existing_evaluator_convention: Existing direct link evaluations should provisionally be read as using an upside-down / dual Kirby-link convention, not as a literal bottom-up implementation of Tham Definition 5.11.
working_understanding.special_dotted_knot_warning: If the original Kirby diagram contains special dotted knots, then under this Tham-5.11-compatible dual interpretation it is more natural to treat them as 3-handle / vacuum-projection data than as ordinary 1-handles directly consumable by the current framed-link evaluator.
working_understanding.why_prior_agreement_is_not_surprising: The observed agreement of complicated prior examples is evidence that the adopted convention is internally consistent; it should not be interpreted as a proof that primal attaching-link evaluation and literal Tham belt-core evaluation are raw-equal without dualization or surgery normalization.
